passes.prompt:
Make a FOCUSED ARCHITECTURAL REPAIR of the CENTRAL STAIR FLIGHT ONLY in this approved railway-station wallpaper. Keep the whole 16:9 wallpaper canvas, camera, woman, face, hair, costume, both hands and ticket, legs/shoes, bag, tall silver divider walls, brass handrails, crowds, palette and hand-painted anime style unchanged. Preserve image dimensions/aspect ratio near 1672x941. No new scene or pose.

The central ground currently reads too much like a flat paved ramp with irregular tile rows. Reconstruct it as ONE COHERENT FLIGHT OF REAL FIXED STONE STAIRS descending away from the foreground camera toward the tiled lower station concourse behind the woman. Baita climbs UP toward the foreground camera. Use identical real-world riser heights and tread depths; apparent tread depth and stair width change gradually with a single consistent perspective. Every step spans the full clear width BETWEEN the two inner sides of the metal partitions, ends at those sides, and has a continuous straight, level leading edge. Corresponding left and right ends are at the same elevation, including steps occluded by the woman's legs. Maintain one orderly sequence behind her, beside her and in the foreground, not mismatched side stair rows.

Give the steps clearly readable horizontal tread surfaces, subtle squared nosings and slim vertical drops oriented consistently with the flight descending toward the back. In this upper-landing view the upper surfaces dominate; avoid a staircase rising toward the background, avoid riser faces alternating direction, and avoid exaggerating the risers into tall brick walls. Replace the irregular cobblestone/block paving and ambiguous extra horizontal seams with large simple stone slabs across each tread; sparse fine joints may run with perspective but must not be confused with extra step edges. No wavy nosings, broken treads, duplicated edges, random grid of tiles or ramps. Clear regular flight geometry with believable joins at both side walls.

Foot support: keep the woman's exact existing planted-shoe position and lifted-knee pose; align the supporting tread underneath the planted loafer so its sole makes real contact on that tread, not on a vertical riser or floating above it. Small dark contact shadow under the sole and a coherent cast shadow on the steps. The lifted foot remains above the next higher tread. Do not change the legs to fit an invented new stair direction.

Integrate existing rail and woman cast shadows coherently: shadows cross successive horizontal treads and break/offset only at the actual step-height transitions. Reflect the same established light direction and cool/warm palette. Use restrained opaque stone planes and a few directional brush marks in our current hand-painted anime block-paint style. The stair structure should be readable without dense painted tile outlines. Keep silver walls and rails untouched and leave all character pixels visually as close to the source as possible. No text, watermark, signature or border.

Correct the PERSPECTIVE AND PROPORTIONS OF THE CENTRAL STAIRCASE in this image. The current repair has excessively deep foreground treads, compressed rear steps, and an incoherent staircase pitch. Rebuild the entire central flight as a measured real architectural stair, not a fan of exaggerated bands. Preserve the landscape wallpaper composition, the woman and her exact pose/identity/clothes/hands/ticket, tall metal dividers, overall rail design, crowd and lighting. Allow tiny changes to the INNER WALL BASE / RAIL POST CONTACTS only where necessary to make them meet the corrected steps.

ARCHITECTURAL CAMERA: fixed camera on the upper landing, looking down at a woman ascending from the lower concourse toward us. Use ONE consistent pinhole perspective and ONE straight flight of stairs, constant real stair width, constant real riser height and constant real tread depth from bottom to top. Normal pedestrian stair dimensions, approximately 16 cm rise and 30 cm tread depth. The entire flight has one constant moderate pitch, no changing slope or curved/concave run. Both side stringer lines and the rails follow that same flight pitch to the same lower landing behind her.

Draw clean full-width horizontal nosing edges, level across the flight. The frontmost step is only moderately larger/deeper in apparent scale than the next; sizes change SMOOTHLY AND PROGRESSIVELY with distance, NOT several huge flat slabs in front followed by tiny dense ladder rungs behind the woman's knees. Remove the current foreground stretch and abrupt change of step frequency. All left and right step-edge endpoints correspond to one another and meet the wall bases at identical elevation. Concealed portions behind legs continue consistently. Simple stone slab treads with minimal seams, no floor paving grid. Subtle physically oriented riser drops and edges consistent with descending away from the upper camera, never a reversed staircase facing the wrong direction. No fan-shaped widening independent of the side walls, no terraced amphitheater, no irregular step heights or alternating depth.

Keep the woman's shoes in their current positions and preserve her high lifted knee. Align one naturally sized support tread below the planted foreground loafer, with full sole contact and small contact shadow; that tread is part of the regular sequence rather than a custom oversized platform. The lifted shoe is free above the next higher step and must not merge into a riser. Continue the same sun and railing shadows over the corrected planes, with subtle offsets at risers; shadows do not define fake step boundaries. Avoid huge dark riser faces or huge bright horizontal stripes.

Paint corrected stone with the same hand-painted anime opaque layered planes, quiet chromatic gray/beige values and a few directional marks. Stair geometry must read from consistent perspective and subtle plane changes, not heavy repeated outlines. Preserve Baita's visible viewer-right green eye and heavy fringe hiding viewer-left eye, gold clips, dark curls, coat, knitted dress, bag and repaired ticket hand exactly. Same wallpaper aspect and unchanged peripheral architecture. This pass is specifically a measured staircase-perspective repair, no new camera, no crop, no restyle, text or watermark.
passes.result: Tread-depth sequence made more gradual; full-width stone step edges, simplified joints and support tread retained. Assistant observation, not user acceptance.

scope: Staircase-specific correction of installed fifth wallpaper; no character redesign.
